verdict.rationale: Convex's docs say you can run the Convex backend on your own servers, and that self-hosted Convex runs the open-source backend with the same up-to-date code as the cloud service. The official GitHub repo adds that self-hosting works with infrastructure such as Postgres, SQLite, Neon, Fly.io and RDS. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, and detailed setup/operations documentation (e.g. deployment steps, dashboard or feature-parity caveats) in the evidence.
